raw_answer_text:
A1: Learning happens unconditionally for every received frame (wire → learn → lookup), before the destination lookup result is known; it does not depend on the destination lookup outcome.
A2: It associates the source MAC address (SA) with the ingress port.
A3: Whether the destination MAC entry is found in the table ("Entry found?"): a miss leads to flooding, while a hit proceeds to a further check that can lead to forwarding.
A4: NOT STATED explicitly, but the flowchart indicates it is flooded to all ports in the VLAN, and the ingress port is always excluded.
A5: NOT STATED separately in the logic — a comment notes both "unknown unicast" and "broadcast/multicast" result in the same "no" (miss) branch, i.e., both are flooded.
A6: When the entry is found but the egress port equals the ingress port (destination is out the same port it arrived on).
A7: NOT STATED.
A8: NOT STATED.
